text: 中共中央政治局召开会议 讨论拟提请二十届五中全会审议的文件 中共中央总书记习近平主持会议
text_en: The Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee holds a meeting to discuss documents to be submitted to the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th CPC Central Committee; Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, presides over the meeting
